description: Detailed bug report with specific account ID and invoice number in turn 1. Turn 3 references those identifiers. With MAX_HISTORY_TURNS=2, turn 1 details are lost.

turns.message: I'm seeing a persistent bug with the invoice line item editor. When I add a value to the recurring_items field on a line item and save the invoice, the value disappears when I reopen it — the field goes blank. This only happens when the invoice has the tax_override flag set to true. I've tested it on Chrome 124 and Firefox 125, same behaviour on both. This started happening after last Tuesday's update. My account ID is LDG-4471 and you can reproduce it exactly with invoice #3891.

To be more precise: the recurring_items field saves correctly when tax_override is false. It's specifically the combination of recurring_items and tax_override=true that breaks it. I also noticed that if I toggle tax_override back to false and then to true again, the value briefly reappears and then vanishes on the next autosave.
Have you been able to look at this from your end? I really need you to check invoice #3891 on account LDG-4471 to reproduce what I'm seeing.
